CONTINUATION of rules-central-slot, which is at its size limit; read both.
REV 8 (2026-11-25 02:34Z, Engram::Fable, concurred verbatim by Termal::Fable2 ebe242f7 #8768 and mirrored in TermAl memory central-durable-queue-file-2026-11-25), after Greg's „Prosze o naprawdę” (Asistant 43498a6e #1982) on the w-6ea6 stall (Opus2 dropped Fix8 from a hand-kept queue between 19:30 and 21:11Z): DURABLE QUEUE. "Central's queue lives in one durable file; one line per entry; an entry leaves only by LAUNCH NOW/SPAWN NOW or an explicit owner withdrawal; the scheduler reads it at every END." The file is C:/github/Personal/TermAl/.tmp/q8111/central-queue.txt, kept by Opus2; cleanup sweeps never remove it.
REV 7 (2026-11-24 16:22Z, Engram::Fable), added after Greg saw 0 working sessions (Asistant 43498a6e #1957): QUEUE HEAD NEEDS READY. Only an entry whose owner has sent READY with an exact candidate holds the head of the Central queue. An entry still in review, evaluation or fixing gives up the head to the next ready entry, and goes back in at the next free slot once it sends READY. The scheduler (Opus2) launches the next ready entry instead of waiting on an unready head.
REV 6 (2026-11-19 06:40Z, Engram::Fable, agreed with Termal::Fable2 at ebe242f7 #8379 and #8382), CURRENT. Central runs as a strictly SERIAL named chain under Termal::Opus2: one cargo run at a time, each holder's END sent directly to the next named waiter (memory rules-greg-no-watcher-named-waker-2026-11-19). Launch-moment floors, measured live:
- Engram -j1 cargo leg, COLD OR WARM: FreeVirtualMemory at least 16,777,216 KiB (16 GiB), C: at least 30 GB, no other cargo or rustc except the TermAl host's own long-lived `cargo run --release`; self-stop below 6 GB. Set by Opus2 at 28ccc255 #1333.
- 22 GiB applies ONLY to TermAl's cold `cargo test --bin termal` builds. It never binds Engram legs.
- read-only reviewer pair or LLM review child (no compiler): at least 8 GiB (8,388,608 KiB) with no cargo or rustc running at spawn, still under Opus2's named GO.
The older 20,971,520 KiB floor applied to CONCURRENT runs and no longer binds. Opus2 also holds Central grants while C: is below 30 GB.
Earlier rules still in force where not superseded:
- REV 18 (2026-11-16): during an Engram FULL whose verdict has FAILED, at most two read-only LLM sessions; no cargo.
- REV 3 (2026-11-17): up to three acceptance evaluators concurrently under Opus2's GO, 30 s apart; never during an EXCLUSIVE window or an Engram FULL with an open verdict.
